app.name: TripAgent
app.demoBadgeTitle: Running on recorded data. Set VITE_DEMO_MODE=false to use the live API.

setup.intro: Tell us where and when, and what you enjoy. We'll build a map-checked plan with a Plan B for everything that matters.
setup.budgetHelp: Total for the trip. Leave blank if you'd rather not set one.
setup.freeTextLabel: Tell us more about your trip
setup.freeTextPlaceholder: For example: First time in Seattle. I love coffee, bookstores and photography, want places locals enjoy, I'm vegetarian, and I'd rather not travel more than 30 minutes between stops.
setup.freeTextHelper: The more you share, the more personal your plan. You can edit everything we pick up.
setup.freeTextOverLimit: That's a little long. We'll use the first {max} characters.
setup.demoNote: Demo mode: everything runs on recorded data.

understood.assumed: We assumed this. Tap to change.
understood.inferred: We guessed this from your note. Tap to change.
understood.empty: Add a few details and we'll show what we picked up.

clarify.intro: A quick question before we plan
clarify.questionCount: {count, plural, one {1 quick question} other {# quick questions}}
clarify.contradiction: You picked driving, but your note says you won't have a car. How will you get around?

planning.title: Building your plan
planning.slow: Still working. Checking travel times takes longer for bigger trips.
planning.degraded: Live travel times are unavailable right now, so we used recent estimates. We'll refresh them when the service is back.

itinerary.undoTooltip: Restore the previous version of your plan.
itinerary.reducedMotion: Animations are reduced based on your device settings.

validation.pass: Everything fits: hours, travel times and budget.
validation.softWarning: Day {day} has three cafés in a row. Want more variety?
validation.msgLeg: A leg on this day is over your {max}-minute travel limit.
validation.msgSameCategory: Some stops in a row are the same kind. Want more variety?
validation.msgLowVariety: This day has fewer than three kinds of activity. Want more variety?
validation.msgOverBudget: This plan goes over your budget.
validation.msgOutsideHours: A stop is scheduled outside its listed opening hours.
validation.estimatedCostTooltip: Estimated from the price level. Actual prices may vary.
validation.signalTooltip: Based on ratings and review patterns, not an official label.
validation.unknownHours: Hours not listed. Check before you go.
validation.noBackups: No backup found nearby yet. We'll search again if this falls through.
validation.lockTooltip: Keep this activity no matter what changes.

adjust.placeholder: For example: I'm running 90 minutes late, or my budget is now $300.
adjust.needsClarification: We didn't catch what changed. Try something like "I'm 1 hour late" or "skip museums".

changeSummary.title: Your trip is updated
changeSummary.triggerLine: Because {trigger}, we changed {n, plural, one {1 activity} other {# activities}} and kept {m}.
changeSummary.keptItem: Kept {m, plural, one {1 activity} other {# activities}} as planned.
changeSummary.approvalBody: This change touches more than two activities. Review the proposal on the map, then apply it or keep your plan.

infeasible.title: We couldn't fit this trip
infeasible.noPlan: We couldn't fit this trip. Your ${budget} budget is below the known cost of any full day in {city}. Try raising the budget, shortening the trip, or allowing free activities only.
infeasible.travelLimit: Some days can't stay under {minutes} minutes between stops. Allow up to {suggested} minutes, or plan fewer areas per day?

errors.unknown: Something went wrong while planning. Your trip is saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.providerDown: Live travel times are unavailable right now, so we used recent estimates. We'll refresh them when the service is back.
errors.changeNotUnderstood: We didn't catch what changed. Try something like "I'm 1 hour late" or "skip museums".
errors.tripNotFound: We couldn't find that trip. Start a new one.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load this page. Try again.

trace.title: Agent trace
trace.subtitle: Nodes, tool calls and loop iterations for this run.
trace.empty: No events yet. Plan a trip to see the agent work.
